QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Rolling with Kupo
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bKupo#k at the #bExplorer Base#k to proceed.
QuestInfo.1:
Kupo told you that the Colossus Road was inaccessible on foot. 

Perhaps you can catch a ride...
QuestInfo.2: Valerie doesn't look so good. The rough ride triggered her motion sickness, and she has no choice but to walk to the summit.

1.msg: #b(Valerie doesn't look so good. What's going on?)

2.msg: I'm sorry... I'm fine no matter how bad the stormy seas are, but on land... I-I don't think I can do it.

3.msg: It's 3 days and 2 nights on foot to the summit where Stone Colossus is, right? I-I'll walk there. #bYou head up on Kupo's Ride#k.

1.0: Doesn't this look awesome? Don't you just want to GO on it?

yes.0: Ugh... I'm sorry. I really can't take it. I'll walk the rest of the way. See you at the summit!

npc.0: Oh no, your friend looks ill. Hm, it happens to the best of us. Some people just can't handle the speed.
